verdict.rationale: The docs describe built-in session memory that automatically keeps conversation history across multiple agent runs, so persistence across turns within a session is covered. The pack does not show long-term memory shared across separate sessions or threads, such as user facts or semantic memory retrieved later. It also says nothing about durable storage backends. Missing for 10: cross-session/cross-thread long-term memory, documented persistent storage backends, memory retrieval or management APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
